name: Arsine
state_and_key_properties: Gas; bp -62.5 C; mp -111.2 C; extremely toxic; decomposition begins ~230-240 C
growth_temp_basis: GaAs CVD with TMGa 700-900 C; InAs OMVPE with TMIn from 600 down to 275 C; GaAs ALE 450-700 C

name: tert-Butylarsine
state_and_key_properties: Liquid; bp 65-67 C; decomposition onset ~350 C; GaAs surface lowers it by up to 200 C
growth_temp_basis: GaAs with TEGa 350-700 C; InAs with TMIn 480-540 C; (Ga,In)As on InP 570-650 C; decomposition onset ~350 C, catalytic lowering up to 200 C on GaAs

name: Tris(dimethylamino)arsine
state_and_key_properties: Liquid; mp -53 C; bp 55 C at 10 mm; moisture sensitive; no As-H bonds
growth_temp_basis: ALE with TMGa at 500 C; with TEGa it widens the ALE temperature range (value not extracted)

name: Tris(trimethylsilyl)arsine
state_and_key_properties: bp 82-84 C at 4 Torr; with MX3 gives MAs + 3 Me3SiX
growth_temp_basis: Ambient-pressure CVD of GaAs with GaCl3/Me3Ga (substrate temperature not extracted)

name: Tris(triethylsilyl)arsine
state_and_key_properties: GaAs ALD with GaCl3; window 175-200 C; amorphous stoichiometric films; physical data not verified
growth_temp_basis: Window 175-200 C (J. Mater. Chem. C 2016); patent examples 100 and 120 C; As source held at 50-70 C

name: Trimethylarsine
state_and_key_properties: Liquid; mp -87.3 C; bp 56 C; flash point -25 C; carbon contamination
growth_temp_basis: Alkylarsines typically need 550-800 C for GaAs; InAsP MOVPE at 700 C

name: Diethylarsine
growth_temp_basis: Typical alkylarsine range; reasonable GaAs under certain conditions

name: Tris(trifluoromethyl)arsine
state_and_key_properties: bp ~33 C; etches GaAs under most conditions; growth only at low V/III
growth_temp_basis: Growth only at low V/III and above 250 Torr; etches GaAs (temperature not extracted)
